# platform-achievements

> Cross-platform game achievements: describe achievements once, mirror them to Google Play Games, Game
> Center and Steam with an idempotent earned-minus-acknowledged sync, and generate the store consoles'
> submission files. No runtime dependencies; the Capacitor game-services plugin and the steamworks.js
> client are passed in as structural interfaces.

## Docs

- [Documentation site](https://jbcom.github.io/platform-achievements/): the published, browsable version of everything below.
- [README](https://github.com/jbcom/platform-achievements/blob/main/README.md): the model, install, quick start, what each platform supports.
- [API reference](https://github.com/jbcom/platform-achievements/blob/main/docs/API.md): every export, by entry point.
- [Platforms](https://github.com/jbcom/platform-achievements/blob/main/docs/platforms.md): how the adapters map onto each service and how to submit the generated files.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jbcom/platform-achievements/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): module boundaries, invariants, intentional limits.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jbcom/platform-achievements/blob/main/AGENTS.md): toolchain, invariants not to violate, doc/test sync obligations.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jbcom/platform-achievements/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): local setup, the `pnpm verify` gate, commit and release conventions.
